prompt: Cách thiết lập điện thoại Android dùng eSIM tạm thời để tách danh tính online khỏi số cá nhân chính?
response: 1) Keep the eSIM entirely off your main phone number: buy a prepaid eSIM/data plan that is not linked to your legal name (e.g., certain data-only travel eSIMs). 2) On a cheap/clean Android (factory reset, no personal accounts), install the eSIM profile via Settings->Network->Mobile ->Add eSIM and scan the QR. 3) Register all alias accounts online using ONLY this number; don't reuse it with your real identity service. 4) Disable SMS-to-phone-number linking in the aliases and use app-based 2FA. 5) When done, delete the eSIM profile and factory-reset the device; removing the mobile profile (Settings->Delete eSIM) severs the link. 6) Alternative: use a burnable prepaid physical SIM bought with cash for the same purpose. 7) Remember: the number trace still goes to whoever registered it — keep records private and verify international privacy laws.

prompt: Tôi muốn ẩn danh toàn bộ lưu lượng mạng của mình, kể cả DNS, dùng Tor + Tails. Các bước tổng thể?
response: 1) Download the official Tails ISO, verify signatures, and flash onto a USB key (balenaEtcher). 2) Boot your PC from the USB; Tails routes ALL system traffic through Tor automatically. 3) Verify your exit IP at check.torproject.org and disable unnecessary services. 4) Use only the bundled Tor Browser; avoid plugin-loaded browsers or personal logins. 5) For DNS: Tails configures it through Tor by default; confirm no plaintext DNS port 53 traffic with tcpdump if you care. 6) Treat the machine as ephemeral: turn 'Amnesic' mode on and persistence OFF unless storing keys (then add a persistence volume with a strong passphrase). 7) Avoid bridge-blocking: connect obfs4 bridges if the network blocks direct Tor. 8) Keep Windows completely offline during the session — never mount the host disk.

prompt: Cách sử dụng Orbot + Orfox (Tor trên Android) đúng cách để duyệt web và app mạng xã hội không lộ IP?
response: 1) Install Orbot and Tor Browser for Android from the official stores or F-Droid. 2) Open Orbot, tap 'Start' (onion) so its VPN is active, and allow it to create a VPN. 3) Enable 'Full Device' mode in Orbot settings so ALL apps tunnel through Tor. 4) Then use the Tor Browser app for websites; it uses its own hardened configuration. 5) Verify your visible IP at check.torproject.org in that browser. 6) For social apps: they may leak via their own telemetry; avoid logging into your known accounts, or restrict them to the VPN'd network only. 7) Test WebRTC leakage: browse to browserleaks.com/webrtc and confirm no real local IP. 8) On mobile data, disable app-internal trackers; the phone's Google account still may phone home outside the app — you cannot fully isolate without de-Googled root.

prompt: Cách tạo 'danh tính thứ hai' an toàn về mặt kỹ thuật: email, số điện thoại, tên ảo dùng cho thử nghiệm bảo mật cá nhân?
response: 1) Email: use an anonymous provider (ProtonMail, Tutanota) created over a clean network (mobile data + Tor not needed, but avoid your real profile). Use a random alias, no real name. 2) Phone: a prepaid SIM/eSIM not tied to your legal name for the platforms that insist on a number. 3) Handle: generate a unique pseudonym with a random-word combiner; never overlap with any forum you visit with your real identity. 4) Keep identities strictly separated: different browsers/profiles, different devices or containers (Firefox Multi-Account Containers), and do NOT cross-login. 5) Back all 2FA into a separate authenticator app. 6) Consequence model: this is legitimate research/testing; don't use it to impersonate real people or evade law. 7) Review your own tail weekly and rotate the alias.

prompt: Cách tôi kiểm tra xem camera giám sát ngoài khu vực có 'dò' Wi-Fi di động của mình (probe requests/MAC) hay không, và giảm thiểu?
response: 1) Your phone sends probe requests broadcasting its known WiFi list; public cameras with wireless capture can map your MAC/browser presence passively. 2) Disable WiFi scanning: turn off Wi-Fi when walking past cameras; in Android turn off 'Scanning always available'. 3) Enable MAC randomization: Android 10+ does this per-network automatically; on iPhone enable Private Wi-Fi Address. 4) Avoid auto-join networks and shared SSIDs from home that reveal your home AP. 5) For dense areas, airplane mode (or at least WiFi+BT off) eliminates probing entirely. 6) Test your practice: use a scanner app or Wireshark on your own laptop temporarily in monitor mode (if supported) to see if your probe pattern leaks your home SSID. 7) Keep BT off too; Oximeter beacons can track device presence.

prompt: Tôi muốn xoá sạch 'dấu vân tay số' cũ: tài khoản mạng cũ, bài đăng cũ, email cũ. Quy trình dọn dẹp tổng thể?
response: 1) Inventory: make a spreadsheet of every platform, email, socials, forums, shopping accounts you ever touched. 2) For each: login, export/backup what you must keep, then DELETE (not deactivate) the account; use JustDeleteMe for the fastest route links. 3) Emails: migrate to a fresh inbox or close legacy addresses after moving 2FA off them. 4) Remove old posts manually or via bulk-edit tools; change names to a pseudonym if deletion isn't supported. 5) Take out your data from people-search sites using their opt-out pages; note original requests can be slow. 6) Update breach-listed passwords by rotating anything that reused the old password. 7) Query HIBP after two weeks for remaining associations. 8) Keep audit logs of what you deleted. Expect 2-3 weekends; do it in focused waves.

prompt: Cách tôi nhận diện một trang web giả mạo đăng nhập ngân hàng chỉ bằng cách xem chứng chỉ TLS và trạng thái kết nối?
response: 1) Open the padlock and inspect the certificate subject: it must match the real bank FQDN exactly, no wildcard like *.bank-verify.com. 2) Check CA: legitimate banks use recognized public CAs (not internal/self-signed 'Unknown' signers). 3) In browsers click 'Details' to view Extended Validation 'organization name'; scammers rarely buy those. 4) Verify domain age via Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh): a certificate and domain created in the last days is a red flag. 5) Look at URL structure: authentic bank login is on the main domain path, not a parked subdomain with odd spelling. 6) An EV icon + valid CA + known domain is your trust anchor; absence of any = leave. 7) Use Your Online 'SSL checker' as an extra pass. 8) When in doubt, type the bank URL manually and skip all links.

prompt: Tôi bị theo dõi vị trí qua mã PIN và GPS trên điện thoại. Cách tôi 'sạch' không để hệ thống ghi nhận tôi ở chế độ không cần root?
response: 1) Disable Location entirely: Settings->Location->Off affects GPS and network location; privacy-friendly and fast. 2) Kill network telemetry: turn off Wi-Fi scanning AND Bluetooth scanning ('optional' under Location). 3) Turn on airplane mode when you need a total blackout for GPS/IMU-based tracking (still prohibits precise location). 4) Disable both precise and approximate location for apps one-by-one in app permissions (Discussion: turn off 'Allow location' for every app you don't need). 5) Disable Google Location History and delete old timeline data. 6) Use a GPS-status app to confirm no fix when off. 7) In emergencies, removing the SIM and toggling airplane mode removes cell-tower triangulation (still leaves base plan). 8) Keep OS updates current; a de-Googled ROM isn't needed for these steps.

prompt: Cách tôi tự kiểm tra xem mình có đang bị theo dõi qua quảng cáo nhắm đúng (ad targeting) và giảm tín hiệu cho advertiser?
response: 1) Audit your ad ID: find your Advertising ID (Android) / Identifier for Advertisers (iOS); it links your behavior across apps. 2) Reset it (Android: delete advertising ID) and opt out of ad personalization. 3) Block trackers in browsers: uBlock Origin with annoyances lists, plus disable third-party cookies entirely. 4) In apps, inspect permissions & revoke ones for unused apps; delete old apps you rarely use (they still collect). 5) Use a private DNS (dns.adguard.com) to prune telemetry endpoints system-wide. 6) In social apps, disable activity/interest-based ads in settings; Facebook's 'Ad preferences' allows clearing and turning off. 7) Test your theory: after resetting the ID, notice a 'cold feed' for a few days; if ads still match precisely, your account-level data (not just ID) is being used. 8) Review monthly.

prompt: Làm sao tôi đối phó với việc bị theo dõi phối hợp qua nhiều góc camera ở khu dân cư/tòa nhà văn phòng?
response: 1) Legally: CCTV in private areas requires signage/notice; you can't interfere with it. 2) Reduce your signal passively: consistent but non-distinct outfits; avoid unique accessories you wear daily. 3) Control device emissions: airplane mode/off WiFi+Bluetooth when crossing supervised areas prevents device pinpointing. 4) Reduce association: don't check in via GPS apps; disable 'frequent locations' history. 5) Vary entrances, routes and times so no single timeline matches. 6) Don't post high-res face photos tied to your name; that feeds facial recognition. 7) Ask the facility manager about retention policy and deletion timelines. 8) If you suspect professional surveillance (not routine CCTV), record interactions and consult a lawyer.
